descriptions.text: The cryptocurrency exchange XT has reportedly fallen victim to a hacking incident, resulting in the loss of approximately $1.7 million worth of crypto assets. The hacker has converted the funds into 461.58 ETH and deposited them into the address 0xB43f…8F83.

On 28 November 2024, attackers stole nearly $1.7 million in platform-owned assets from XT Exchange's hot wallet, exploiting weaknesses in wallet management and monitoring across Ethereum, Polygon, and Optimism. No user funds were affected, and withdrawals were fully restored after verification. Compromise of the exchange's platform-owned hot wallet key enabled unauthorized multi-token withdrawals. XT.COM's post-mortem attributes the breach to insufficient real-time wallet monitoring and delayed correlation between automated alerts, but does not disclose whether the compromise originated internally or externally.
